known_patches: Integer internal seed ids and synthetic account1/2
Constant calendar tag represented as runtime-compatible scalar
limitations: All 18 source tools retained. Raw text and scalar metadata only; no DAV transport, serialized-content parsing, UID/etag derivation, recurrence evaluation or notification delivery certified.
Source guards check authentication and row existence, not collection/share owner authorization; owner-scoped share_list does not imply comprehensive ACLs.
calendaritem_move changes collection_path but does not implement overwrite or destination collision semantics; collection_delete does not cascade calendar items.

share_toggle requires explicit EnabledByUser/HiddenByUser values; action string itself does not select the state. Fixed token share identifier supports one token; no secure token generation or share permission execution claimed.
calendaritem_sync creates empty SyncToken metadata; no incremental delta semantics claimed.
